get.summary: Retrieve all tags (custom and system tags)
get.description:
This API is used to retrieves all available tags in the system, including both system-defined and custom-created tags. You can use the optional query parameter `is_system_tag` to filter the results:

Examples:
  - To retrieve all system-defined tags:
    GET /v2/analytics/tags?is_system_tag=true

  - To retrieve all custom-created tags:
    GET /v2/analytics/tags?is_system_tag=false

parameters.name: tag_type
parameters.description: This parameter is used to set the filter the to retrieve either system tags or custom tags at a time.

schema.title: Success
schema.description: Schema for the successful response of fetching all custom and system tags.

tags.description: List of the retrieved tags based on the specified parameters.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the retrieved tag.

description.example: Indicates whether this transaction represents a credit. This will always be true if the value of amount is positive.

color.description: Hexadecimal color code of tag in Dashboard.

is_system_tag.description: Indicates whether the tag is system-defined (`true`) or custom-created (`false`).

created_ts.description: Timestamp when the retrieved tag was created.

updated_ts.description: Timestamp when the retrieved tag was last updated.

get.description: This API is used to retrieve details of a specific tag based on the specified `tag_uuid`. The response includes the tag's name, description, color, type (system or custom), include and exclude terms, and other configuration details.

parameters.name: tag_uuid
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the tag whose details are to be retrieved.

schema.title: Success
schema.description: Schema for successful retrieval of a tag details.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the tag whose details are retrieved.

color.description: Hexadecimal color code of tag in Dashboard.

is_system_tag.description: Indicates whether the tag is a system-defined tag (`true`) or a custom tag (`false`).

created_ts.description: Timestamp when the tag was created.

updated_ts.description: Timestamp when the tag was last updated.

include_terms.description: Terms that will apply the specified tag when found in the transaction description.

exclude_terms.description: Terms which when found in the description of transaction would be tagged as the above tag.

gt.description: The specified greater than value. If a transaction has an amount greater than the specified value, the system will automatically apply the tag to that transaction.

lt.description: The specified less than value. If a transaction has an amount less than the specified value, the system will automatically apply the tag to that transaction.

eq.description: The specified equal to value. If a transaction has an amount equal to the specified value, the system will automatically apply the specified tag to that transaction.

max_days.description: The maximum numebr of days until when the transction is ignored. If a transaction recur within the specified `max_days`, the system will automatically apply the specified tag to that transaction.

min_days.description: The minumum numebr of days until when the transction is ignored. If a transaction recur within the specified `min_days`, the system will automatically apply the specified tag to that transaction.
